title: creeper_geming's PVP modpack
description: A lightweight and highly optimized Fabric modpack designed for Minecraft 1.21.11 Significantly boosts FPS and improves overall performance while adding helpful quality-of-life and visual enhancements.
body:
# ✨ Ultimate Performance & FPS Boost Modpack (Fabric 1.21.11)

Welcome to your ultimate Minecraft optimization pack! This collection of mods is carefully selected to deliver the smoothest gameplay experience possible on Fabric 1.21.11 without changing the vanilla survival feel. 
Tested and perfectly optimized to run flawlessly on your setup (Intel i3-12100, 16GB RAM, AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB).

## 🚀 Key Features:
* **Massive FPS Boost:** Includes top-tier optimization mods like Sodium, Lithium, ModernFix, C2ME, and FerriteCore to eliminate lag and stuttering.
* **Enhanced Visuals & Audio:** Beautiful shaders support (via Iris), custom animations, better hitboxes, and immersive sound mechanics.
* **Quality of Life (QoL):** Convenient features such as Xaero's Minimap & World map, AppleSkin, Mod Menu, and Shulker Box Tooltips.
* **Stability:** Fully equipped with required dependencies (Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin, Indium, etc.) to ensure zero crashes.

---

# ✨ Yuqori unumdorlik va FPS oshiruvchi Modpack (Fabric 1.21.11)

Minecraftni optimallashtirish uchun mo'ljallangan mukammal to'plamga xush kelibsiz! Ushbu modlar jamlanmasi asl o'yin uslubini o'zgartirmagan holda, Fabric 1.21.11 versiyasida eng silliq o'yin jarayonini ta'minlash uchun sinchkovlik bilan tanlangan.
Sizning kompyuteringizda (Intel i3-12100, 16GB RAM, AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB) xatolarsiz va qotmasdan ishlashi uchun mukammal optimallashtirilgan.

## 🚀 Asosiy imkoniyatlar:
* **Kuchli FPS oshishi:** Qotishlarni yo'qotish uchun Sodium, Lithium, ModernFix, C2ME va FerriteCore kabi eng yaxshi optimizatsiya modlarini o'z ichiga oladi.
* **Vizual va ovozli yaxshilanishlar:** Shaderlarni qo'llab-quvvatlash, animatsiyalar va yaxshilangan ovoz mexanikalari.
* **Qulayliklar:** Xaero's Minimap va World map, AppleSkin, Mod Menu va Shulker Box Tooltips kabi qulay funksiyalar.
* **Barqarorlik:** Xatolarsiz ishlashini ta'minlash uchun barcha kerakli yordamchi kutubxonalar (Fabric API, Fabric Language Kotlin, Indium va boshqalar) bilan jihozlangan.
